title: P^A subset NP^A for every oracle A
informal: Any language that can be decided by a deterministic polynomial-time oracle machine (P^A) can also be verified by a nondeterministic polynomial-time oracle machine (NP^A), for every oracle A.

probes.question: Over what does the claim range?
probes.hint: plain-language: does this have to work for ALL oracles, or just some helpful one?

probes.question: Which direction does the containment go?
probes.hint: plain-language: 'P is a subset of NP' means one-way — everything in P is in NP, not the reverse.

probes.question: What kind of time bound does the claim use?
probes.hint: The theorem says the machine runs in AT MOST polynomial steps — a ceiling, not an exact count.

probes.question: Does the claim assert a witness exists?
probes.hint: NP means 'there exists a short certificate that verifies membership' — existence of a witness is the point.
